description: Enable the test cases that were previously skipped in the compaction and WAL acceptor test suites. These tests were introduced as part of the hadron integration work but were left disabled. The goal is to activate these tests to ensure the integration is functioning correctly and to improve test coverage.
functional_requirements: Enable all previously skipped test cases in the compaction test suite.
Enable all previously skipped test cases in the WAL acceptor test suite.
Ensure the enabled tests run successfully as part of the standard test execution.
